notes.title: First Milestone Communique: What Artisan Acre Has to Offer at 4th Month?
notes.content: [p][b][i]Allô! Artisan![/i][/b] [/p][p][/p][p]I am [b]Thep[/b], the only developer of this vintage food simulation [i](or "The Cheese Game" as people call it).[/i][/p][p]It's been [i]4 months and several days[/i] since I start this project, and [i]3 months[/i] since I launched this Steam page. The current game version is "[i][b]PRE-ALPHA 3b[/b][/i]" which will be ready to be released as demo in the next few months.[/p][p]So, I think the time is extremely ripe - maybe too ripe - for me to write this milestone announcement, so that you know if the game is right for you - at its current state.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Ahem... Starting my presentation![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/09e14c2bc206ea14d9e8e55e86962638b638e6ab.png"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="PVvUjd_2u40;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Not much game present first-person kitchen experience, let alone the one that features artisan products like cheese, wine, and a lot more.[/i][/p][p]I know that fact very well. So, after 5 years of trying and failing, I am proud to present this game to you: [b]Artisan Acre[/b]![/p][p]I define this game as [i][b]"Artisan Culinary Simulation"[/b][/i], which mean exactly what it says.[/p][p][/p][p][i]To be more precise, this game, at this version, offers you...[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]First-Person Kitchen/Workshop[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i][b]Place the pot. Add the milk. Pick the spoon up and stir the pot. Oh! the table is off for 2º! Let's pick it up and adjust it![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Not every real-life kitchen is perfect and capable of making cheese, wine, and stuff. This game will be your virtual kitchen - a workshop, where you control everything happening inside.[/p][p]And that's my goal! I want players to experience the artisanal craft, and the feeling of owning the place where they're capable to do so.[/p][p]Every production included in this game was mirrored from the real-world. [/p][p][/p][p]And you can move almost all of the thing in your workshop![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/dc8f2c2ad743088a7f51ad46b2f1f2d59ec6c2df.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Artisanal Food Production[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b][i]Cheese, wine, bread, and a lot more that was not already planned[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]The mentioned products are all my passion (although cheese is my most loved content!).[/p][p]And I assure you, with this game, you will be able to put on the boots as a person who work with these things.[/p][p]And as you may have known producing these products depend on various factors aside from the ingredients, which you will have to master too along the journey, including... [i](Go to the next section I meant)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/775a7d33e04d2e45f883571bf27774decf0d9d74.png"][/img]  [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Temperature and Seasonal Changes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Temperature and season extremely affect the production of [i]almost everything[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Let's say it's a cheese called [i]camembert[/i]. In this game, it needs to be aged at around [i]12-21ºC for 4 months.[/i] If the temperature is outside of range, the process may stop, and the cheese might be overrun by unwanted yeast and mold before it's ready, effectively spoiling it.[/p][p][/p][p]I know it might sound intimidating at first, but I assure you, you don't have to remember this thing at first.[/p][p][/p][p]One method to control temperature is very direct; Just put your stuff on stove, the temperature will increase. Take it out of the stove, it will cool down.[/p][p][/p][p]Another is the star of [b]Artisan Acre[/b]: Artisanal products are notoriously dependent on changing season - time of year, mostly for their aging/affinage stage that could take from 3 days to full 3 years![/p][p]With that as the reason, you may need to plan your production of a product according to the season.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/756bce6e48dfb475034112508e0852b3ec899162.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Mold and Microbe[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Mold and microbe extremely affect the production of [i]almost everything too[/i].[/p][p]Many production processes need them, like yeast for dough proofing, blue mold for blue cheese, and so on, and so on.[/p][p]You can simply add one in from a packet or manipulate them. There will be various way you can get your desired mold for the cheese or anything.[/p][p][/p][p]But as you may have suspected, not all mold is a good guy. [/p][p]Failure to eliminate any bad one and let it through the production may affect the product in a bad way, or even worse: to the customer, because... you can guess the reason![/p][p][/p][p]Roughly, some mold and microbe that exist in the game includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]White mold[/b] ([i]Penicillium candidum[/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blue mold[/b] ([i]Penicillium roqueforti[/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Creamy mold[/b] ([i]Geotrichum candidum[/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Food poisoning bacteria[/b] ([i]E. coli and others[/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Baker's yeast [/b]for bread (and beer brewing in the future!)[/p][/*][/list][p]And various planned mold and bacteria, largely related to cheesemaking and winemaking [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/1ebde6bf2b0abefbd5f3f70e610a556df011fc67.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Planned Food Products[/b][/h2][p]In my plan, the earliest release of the game will include the following food products:[/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]La Fromagerie[/b][/i] (Cheesemaking)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/b08a7e47d10877f5c303333fdba39ab4c797be70.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Curd your milk with rennet. Settle your curd with stove. Mold or press the curd. Age the wheel in the cellar.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Cheese is why this game or even its ancestor was born. It was my greatest passion.[/p][p][/p][p]You will start from curding your milk to aging your cheese.[/p][p]The curding stage needs direct temperature control, with your stove.[/p][p]The aging stage needs planning: season, time of year, type of cheese.[/p][p]But one thing greatly dictates the outcome: THE MOLD. Wrong mold, the outcome changes.[/p][p][/p][p]Currently at this version, there are 4 cheeses, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Camembert[/b] made with soft curd and white mold[b].[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]"Firm Blue Cheese"[/b] mirroring from French [i]Roquefort, [/i]made with firm curd and blue mold[b].[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cheddar [/b]made with pressed cooked curd.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"Crumbly Large Blue Cheese"[/b] mirroring from British [i]Blue Stilton, [/i]made with pressed cooked curd and blue mold[b].[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]At least 10-36 type are planned (very large range of number for my safety hehe). Most differ from each other by their milk type, curd stage, molding method, size, and mold type.[/p][p][/p][p]As for the milk, there will be cow milk, ewe milk, goat milk, and buffalo milk.[/p][p]There is milk quality, which roughly represent protein and fat amount. This value will differ depending on supplier relationship and time of year; Milk has more fat in winter.[/p][p][/p][p]As for the mold, mainly, there will be white mold ([i]Penicillium Candidum[/i]), blue mold ([i]Penicillium Roqueforti and P. Glaucum[/i]), and creamy mold ([i]Geotrichum Candidum[/i]). Don't worry, you don't have to remember that long name.[/p][p][/p][p][i]As you see, some cheeses use generic name. This is because most cheese names are protected by the law like EU's PDO or PGI. While I am able to mirror large part of the production processes into the game, I respect the law and the producer/seller exclusive rights to use the name.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]La Boulangerie[/b][/i] (Bakery)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/a75120ed46e475fe0a573a46a6b10117df863dc8.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Make dough with flour and water. "Add" the yeast. Shape it. Proof it. Bake it. Sell it quickly![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Bakery is the simplest product in the game at this stage.[/p][p]It is easy to make, as mentioned. But it needs to be made day-by-day, else it will stale![/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the bread include:[/p][list][*][p]Baguette[/p][/*][*][p]Boule Bread (Circular bread)[/p][/*][*][p]Flat bread[/p][/*][/list][p]A lot more is planned, including laminated dough like croissants, or the richer and decorated one like Panettone![/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]La Vinothèque[/b][/i] (Winemaking)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/ec8734aa95a0644ff5305d4b9a749c2bea6c3f12.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Wait for the grape! Order it! Sort it! Crush it! Press it! Ferment it! Age it![/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]That comical paragraph describes how complex the winery part of Artisan Acre will be.[/p][p]Grape is available only at an exact period of year. Each year's harvest differs.[/p][p]There are several varieties of grape, like [i]Cabernet Sauvignon[/i] and [i]Chardonnay[/i].[/p][p]And there will be processes and temperature that affect the final outcome.[/p][p][/p][p]I can speak much about the winemaking part for now, as it's in extremely early stage.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Boutique - The Shop[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Sell it! Sell it! Sell it![/b][/p][p][/p][p]In short, it's where you sell your stuff.[/p][p]Customer will place their order. The order will include both things that you got in hand or not.[/p][p][/p][p]As planned, there will be special character that you can interact and talk to.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/5b76b9a36de556962d135df2d7e0e3a7777dfba3.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Realism?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i][b]The gameplay is realistic, yet simplified.[/b][/i][/p][p]Although some mechanics and processes are simplified or removed, they're design to at least contains the crucial part of their real-world counterpart.[/p][p]If you know how to do something in real-life, you can probably do it in the game, and vice versa.[/p][p]Which mean if you learn how to do stuffs in the game, you will have at least the basic knowledge framework on how do it in real-life.[/p][p]In short, you can consider this game an educational game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646393/2a77eecd8f138b5a3333e831b5c9119cd84d8014.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Moving Train[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i]*whoooooooooooooooooooosh*[/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BrMwEGMW5Ec;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]So yep, that should be all notable feature and... fact? - something like that, in this current version.[/p][p]Sorry for not posting anything here since the launch of this Steam page. (TBH it affects me more haha)[/p][p]I will try to post more fun thing here from now as I see how much entertaining it is to work with the format![/p][p]And thank you for reading this. It means a lot.[/p][p]You can ask any question in your mind, I am more than happy to answer, and opinion too! Those will help my development a lot.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Merci Beaucoup![/b][/i][/p][p][i][b]Thep[/b][/i][/p]
